description: Model registry — the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for tag -> model_id AND pricing. A `tag` is the short alias used across local files and the plugin (agent `.md` frontmatter `model: <tag>`); `model_id` is the real Claude model string, used both to invoke the model and for telemetry. `pricing` (USD per MTok: input/cached_input/output) is authoritative for telemetry cost accounting — the pipeline reads it from here, never restates rates elsewhere. `cache_write_multipliers` price prompt-cache CREATION relative to the model's input rate (Anthropic standard: 5-minute TTL = 1.25x, 1-hour TTL = 2x); the usage tool multiplies the per-turn ephemeral_5m/ephemeral_1h cache-creation token split by these. To bump a model or its price, edit it HERE (README/CORE-TODO/SKILL link here). `pipeline_tiers` lists the tags the pipeline actually dispatches and that hooks/enforce-agent-model.sh enforces (mirror of its is_valid_tier list — keep in sync); the remaining `models` entries are reference/pin-only. NOTE: `sonnet` carries intro pricing through 2026-08-31 — see its pricing.note.
